info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Create Payments Payments Authorize-v5-spec
info.description: The Payment Authorization API facilitates the initiation and processing of payment authorization requests for transactions. This endpoint allows merchants and service providers to request approval for various payment methods, ensuring transaction security and compliance. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and payment service providers that require seamless payment processing capabilities. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently manage payment authorizations and integrate them into their payment workflows.

post.description: This operation allows you to authorize a payment transaction by providing the necessary payment details. It validates the information and returns the authorization status, enabling the user to proceed with the payment processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authorize a payment. It contains the necessary details for processing the authorization, including the payment method, amount, and any relevant transaction metadata.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number for tracking the payment.

customer.description: The details of the customer making the payment.

resource.description: The resource associated with the payment.

priority.description: The priority level of the payment request.

amount.description: The amount to be authorized for payment.

currency.description: The currency in which the payment is made.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates if notification is required after processing the payment.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the payment was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the payment is being made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in a list of payments.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeRequest.description: The request body for authorizing a payment operation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates if the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Information about the customer making the payment.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeResponse_.title: Payments Authorization Response

status.description: Indicates whether the payment authorization was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the payment authorization.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the payment authorization.

state.description: The current state of the payment authorization.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the authorization, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the authorization.

CreatePaymentsPaymentsAuthorizeResponse_.description: Response schema for a successful payments authorization operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the authorization.

createdAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the authorization was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the authorization was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Information related to the audit of the payment authorization.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. A lower value indicates a faster response time.
